nodes.description: Mapping of address to token balance, mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to approved allowance.
Public total token supply set in the constructor.
Public human readable token name.
Public number of decimals used for display.
Public token symbol identifier.
Public arbitrary version string of the token.
StandardToken.transfer moves tokens from msg.sender to _to and always returns a boolean.
StandardToken.transferFrom moves tokens from _from using an allowance granted to msg.sender.
StandardToken.balanceOf constant function returning balances[_owner].
StandardToken.approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] and always succeeds.
StandardToken.allowance constant function returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Fallback function that throws on any plain ether transfer.
COREv2Fork constructor minting all initial tokens to msg.sender and setting metadata.
Approve then invoke receiveApproval on the spender contract via a low level call.
msg.sender controls balances, allowance and the destination of the external call.
balances[msg.sender] -= _value unchecked subtraction in transfer.
balances[_to] += _value unchecked addition in transfer.
balances[_to] += _value unchecked addition in transferFrom.
balances[_from] -= _value unchecked subtraction in transferFrom.
allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value unchecked allowance decrement in transferFrom.
Low level _spender.call of receiveApproval executed after the allowance state update.
Destination address parameter _to used by transfer.
Amount parameter _value used by transfer and other token functions.
Source address parameter _from used by transferFrom.
Spender address parameter _spender used by approve and approveAndCall.
Owner address parameter _owner used by balanceOf and allowance.
Arbitrary bytes parameter _extraData forwarded into the external call.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the authorizing owner whose allowance entry approve writes.
transferFrom checks allowed[_from][msg.sender] and spends the caller's allowance.
msg.sender indexes the balance that is decremented with unchecked arithmetic.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping that is decremented in transferFrom.
approve writes the _value into allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowed mapping.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
balanceOf returns balances[_owner].
allowance returns allowed[_owner][_spender].
Constructor assigns the initial balance of the creator.
Constructor sets totalSupply to the initial minted amount.
Constructor sets the token name.
Constructor sets the decimals value.
Constructor sets the token symbol.
transfer executes the unchecked subtraction of the sender balance.
transfer executes the unchecked addition to the recipient balance.
transferFrom executes the unchecked addition to the recipient balance.
transferFrom executes the unchecked subtraction from the source balance.
transferFrom executes the unchecked allowance decrement.
approveAndCall performs an external call to an attacker controlled spender contract.
The external receiveApproval call can re-enter approveAndCall or other token functions.
_to is used as the destination key of balances in transfer.
_value is directly used in unchecked balance arithmetic in transfer.
_from is used as the source key of balances in transferFrom.
_spender is the allowance target and the contract called by approveAndCall.
_owner is the lookup key of balances in balanceOf.
_extraData is forwarded as raw calldata into the untrusted external call.

normalization_plan.reason: _to has no independent meaning outside transfer and is merged into the transfer function node.
_value is the operand of the unchecked balance subtraction in transfer and merged into that unsafe operation.
_from is only the source key for transferFrom and is merged into the transferFrom function node.
_spender is the target of the approval and the external call inside approveAndCall, so it merges into that function.
_owner is only a lookup key in balanceOf and is merged into that function node.
_extraData is passed as raw data into the low level external call and is merged into that unsafe operation.
